overall_quality.evidence: The average time complexity of Quicksort is O(n log n), where n is the number of elements in the array. However, in the worst case, the time complexity can degrade to O(n^2). This worst-case scenario occurs when the pivot chosen is consistently the smallest or largest element in the array, leading to unbalanced partitions. To mitigate this, various strategies can be employed, such as choosing a random pivot or using the median-of-three method.
